Sweet Corn Recipes Worth Buying a Dozen Ears For

By Katie Workman

Updated Jul 29, 2026

This post may contain affiliate links. Please read our disclosure policy.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 4:58
Instaread

The moment sweet corn shows up at the farmers market, I start buying it by the armful. I absolutely love it straight off the cob with a little butter and salt, eaten standing over the kitchen sink like a completely reasonable person.

But corn is one of the most versatile vegetables of the summer season — sweet enough to hold its own in salads, hearty enough to anchor a chowder, and smoky-delicious when it hits a hot grill. It plays beautifully with bacon, tomatoes, zucchini, cotija cheese, browned butter, and just about anything else you throw at it.

14 Best Sweet Corn Recipes

These are the corn recipes I come back to again and again, all summer long. Pick up a few extra ears this week. Trust me, you are going to want to make all of these.

5 from 3 votes

Grilled Corn on the Cob

Everything you need to know — timing, heat, whether to leave the husks on (spoiler alert- no!) — to make absolutely perfect corn. This is the method I keep coming back to every single summer.
View Recipe
5 from 2 votes

Grilled Corn Salad

Grilling the corn before it goes into this salad makes all the difference — that smoky char takes it somewhere raw corn simply cannot go. The rice vinegar dressing keeps everything light and bright, and the fresh basil pulls it all together beautifully.
View Recipe
5 from 2 votes

Grilled Mexican Street Corn (Elote)

The ultimate corn on the cob preparation, slathered in mayo, cotija cheese, and chili powder. It’s messy and bold and completely addictive. Have plenty of napkins on hand.
View Recipe
5 from 2 votes

Creamy Sweet Corn Soup

This is one of the very few soups I actually crave in the middle of summer. It comes together with just four ingredients, takes about 10 minutes of hands-on time, and turns out the most gorgeous shade of yellow. Serve it chilled on a hot day, and it is pure magic.
View Recipe
5 from 2 votes

Sautéed Corn and Zucchini in Lemony Browned Butter

Browned butter does something extraordinary to a simple vegetable sauté — it adds this nutty, rich depth that makes everything taste more special. This 15-minute side dish feels both elegant and almost effortless.
View Recipe
5 from 4 votes

Summer Corn, Tomato, and Bacon Salad

Corn and tomatoes are the undisputed stars of summer, and this salad lets them shine. Crispy bacon and a creamy cilantro dressing give it a wonderful taco-night energy, and if you want to nudge it toward BLT territory, just add some lettuce.
View Recipe
5 from 8 votes

Corn Pudding

This spoonbread-style corn pudding gets its wonderfully light, fluffy texture from whipped egg whites, with a cornmeal base, and just a touch of cayenne to keep things interesting. I love it at Thanksgiving just as much as I love it next to a simple weeknight roast chicken.
View Recipe
5 from 2 votes

Sautéed Broccolini and Corn

The colors of this dish alone — bright yellow corn against deep green broccolini — are enough to make any dinner plate look beautiful. It comes together in a single skillet in about 15 minutes, and the natural sweetness of the corn balances the mild, slightly earthy broccolini just perfectly.
View Recipe
5 from 2 votes

Sautéed Corn and Zucchini in Lemony Browned Butter

The browned butter adds this deep, nutty richness that plays off the sweetness of the corn in the best possible way, and the lemon brightens it up. It goes with just about everything you’re already making for dinner this time of year.
View Recipe
5 from 4 votes

Shrimp and Corn Salad with Basil Dressing

This is substantial enough to be dinner, fresh enough to feel like summer, and the basil dressing ties the whole thing together in the best possible way.
View Recipe
5 from 1 vote

Hot Crab and Corn Dip

Hot Crab and Corn Dip is the kind of appetizer that clears out within minutes of hitting the table — warm, creamy, and packed with sweet corn and tender crab in every bite. Bring this to a party once and you will be asked to bring it every single time.
View Recipe
5 from 2 votes

Zucchini Corn Fritters

Crispy on the outside, tender in the middle, and packed with the best of summer produce. These work as an appetizer and a side dish; just make more than you think you would need (trust me on this one).
View Recipe
5 from 4 votes

Cowboy Caviar

Sweet corn, black beans, colorful veggies, and a tangy dressing. It comes together quickly, gets better as it sits, and works equally well as a dip with chips or spooned over grilled chicken or fish.
View Recipe
5 from 6 votes

Chicken Corn Chowder

There’s something deeply satisfying and slightly magical about a chowder that manages to feel both hearty and completely appropriate for summer.
View Recipe
